answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities: each new identity pays a 20-unit tax to trade. Like a wharf charging each ship, it cannot be shared across clones, so every copy costs full price. It decays after 30 epochs of honest work, growing slowly like yarrow. Making 100 fakes costs 100 x 20 = 2000 units for 5 units of gain each, a net loss of 1500. An honest agent pays once, keeps undiluted rewards, and like a lotus needs one root, not a hundred copies.
